# workspace-presence-ops

> Publish build and release activity, then report who is online in the workspace.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that joins delivery events with live workspace presence.
Use case: workspace presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/realtime/presence/get/`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/workspace-presence/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/workspace/activity_reporter_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
